title: Case shell with openings and vents
message: An open-top, open-bottom 224 x 178 x 83 mm box of 3 mm walls. Back wall: a 158.75 x 44.45 mm opening 9.625 mm from the left and 8.6 mm up, and a 36 x 77.5 mm opening 179 mm from the left and 2 mm up. Front wall: ten 3 mm wide, 45 mm tall slots from 19 mm up, the first 39 mm from the left, 10 mm apart. Left wall: the same ten slots, the first 39 mm from the front. A 3.3 mm hole through each wall at its centre, 79.5 mm up.
